stemMd: An online archive made its search tool faster, but users spent more time per visit. Which explanation best reconciles these facts?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A few users preferred the old interface.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Faster searches encouraged users to investigate more documents during each visit.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The archive kept its previous subscription price.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The number of registered users increased.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The archive removed some obsolete files.

explanationMd: Faster completion of each search need not shorten a visit if users perform more searches or read more results. The task performed during a visit can expand in response to the improvement.

distractorRationale.a: Preference does not establish the overall increase.
distractorRationale.e: Removing files does not by itself explain longer visits.
distractorRationale.d: More users does not itself explain time per visit.
distractorRationale.c: Stable price does not establish browsing duration.
